newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's state sector reform has progessed well with a large number of state-owned enterprises having been transformed into shareholding companies.
- The People's Bank of China expands its open market operations with a total of 25 banks now approved to directly trade state debt with the central bank.
- Seven years after China opened Pudong to the outside world, a total of 4,400 foreign firms have invested a combined $20 billion yuan in the development zone.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China is the world's lagest VCD market with five million of the video disk players expected to be sold this year.
- Shanghai journalists have pledged to stop taking money in return for writing news stories.
